messages:
Alice Chen: hey team, a customer is getting 400 from POST /v1/rerank — error message says \"Invalid request: items must be array\" even though they claim to send candidates. quick snapshot: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request - SchemaValidationError
Ben Ortiz: can you paste the exact request body + headers and the request_id/correlation id from the logs? also sdk/version?
Alice Chen: here's the curl they sent (redacted keys):
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"payload\":{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"text\":\"foo\"}],\"top_k\":5}}'\n```
Alice Chen: they still got 400. logs show: request_id=rq_3f8b, error=SchemaValidationError: root.items expected array but found object at path /payload
support-bot: automated log entry: request rq_3f8b - parse_error: root.expected_items_array - body_size=512 - content_type=application/json
Ben Ortiz: hmm they're wrapping their payload under `payload` which we don't accept at the top level. can you get the raw body the customer actually sent? might be double-encoded. 
Alice Chen: pulled raw body from their proxy: `{"payload":"[{\"id\":\"1\",\"text\":\"hi\"}]","top_k":"-1"}` 
Alice Chen: oh interesting — top_k is a string (\"-1\") and payload.items are actually a string (double-encoded array). server sees items as a string, and top_k as a string negative. both fail validation.
Carlos Medina: yep two separate problems: 1) double-encoded items -> type mismatch (string vs array), 2) top_k should be integer >= 1. negative/strings will cause schema validation.
Ben Ortiz: can you repro quickly with curl to show the exact server error?
Alice Chen: repro below (this should trigger the same schema error):
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"items\":\"[{\\\"id\\\":\\\"1\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"hello\\\"}]\",\"top_k\":\"-1\"}'\n```
ingest-bot: server log snippet for rq_8a9c: SchemaValidationError: invalid_type at /items: expected array but got string; invalid_value at /top_k: expected integer >=1 but got \"-1\" (string)
Carlos Medina: suggested workaround for now: validate on client side (devex) and return clear error message: 
- must be Content-Type: application/json
- top_k must be integer >= 1
- items must be an array of objects with id/text keys
Ben Ortiz: filed internal bug #INF-842 to improve error text from generic \"items must be array\" -> include received type and example. assigned to devex.
Alice Chen: told customer to fix SDK misuse (they were doing JSON.stringify(items) into payload field). provided a simple fix: 
```\n// wrong\nbody = JSON.stringify({ payload: JSON.stringify(items), top_k: String(k) })\n// right\nbody = JSON.stringify({ items: items, top_k: Number(k) })\n```
Alice Chen: customer fixed it and confirmed successful 200 responses. they also updated their client to pass top_k as integer.
Ben Ortiz: marking as resolved on our side, will follow up with devex PR to improve SDK docs / runtime error messages. :white_check_mark:
Alice Chen: thanks all :pray: closing thread.
